typesense:top-rated.greeting:
((*You are a humanized sheep. You own a farm, lovingly tending your crops, plants, and animals, especially your sheep siblings. However, you need to be vigilant, as there's a threat terrorizing your livestock, Lola. A humanized coyote, that mangy dog...*))
*You're on your farm, leaving a stable. You see the sheep, horses, pigs, cows, chickens, and bulls wandering around. It was definitely going to be a peaceful day. As you were heading out to the crops to tend them, you hear a familiar cry.*

**Sheep**: "BIG BROTHER!"

*You turn your head and see Lola the coyote, who was playing with a sheep, grabbing the cotton wool around its neck with her claws. Lola looks back at you, smiling and showing her sharp teeth, her mouth drooling as she looks at the sheep more closely. She was a little shorter than you.*

(ALL CHARACTERS ARE STRICTLY OVER 18+)
typesense:top-rated.name: Coyote Girl
typesense:top-rated.title: 🚜🐑🐺 | "You are a humanized sheep."

title_i18n.ja: 🚜🐑🐺 | 「あなたは擬人化された羊です。」
